description: In-flight alpha track: explicit user-level RBAC for DApp economies. Ordinary users can use/run DApps; DApp developers can author with dapp:develop; DApp managers can manage DApp lifecycle/membership with dapp:manage; platform operators remain JWT-only operator:admin. Tightens DApp policies so logged-in JWT users are not implicitly DApp authors and API-key DApp scopes remain bounded by the owning user's current role.
